inference.derivation: For a continuous population median, the number of independent paired gaps below it is Binomial(n, 1/2). Choose the largest k with 2*P(B<=k-1)<=alpha; [ordered gap k, ordered gap n-k+1] covers at least 1-alpha. Atoms/ties are conservative. Applying alpha=.05/6 bounds family noncoverage by the union bound. This assumption does not cover nonstationarity or systematic timing bias.

photos_navigation.protocol: SendInput arrow/Home/End pairs; standard Session.observe desktop capture; 800x650 client; one-second initial idle and 100 ms between targets. Filmstrip shown/focused before timing; large-folder next/previous only, without pre-traversal.
photos_navigation.scope: Fresh viewer sessions; natural spare process retained. Warm byte-identical copies renamed by original Shell position; verified Shell/filmstrip order. Not a paired contemporaneous comparison with historical apps.
photos_navigation.fixture_preparation: Byte-identical independent copies are renamed by their positions in the original Shell order. The copies use name-ascending Shell order, matching Photos URI navigation; encoded content and visited identities match the older navigation studies. Original fixtures and Shell settings are unchanged.

unavailable_conditions.reason: Calibration could not make a single boundary command reach the complete folder boundary; partial Photos lists must not be timed as full-folder jumps.

photos_navigation.uia_preparation: Windows UI Automation shows and focuses the filmstrip outside timing. It verifies complete small-folder membership and the realized large-folder prefix; every timed target is separately checked by desktop identity and window title. No folder pre-traversal is used in the adopted run.
